answer: Admission auction stops bulk fakes: each epoch auctions 100 slots. First, each applicant posts one bid; a lotus nursery bids for one slot. Top bids win; bids lock 20 epochs, slots are non-transferable, losers refunded. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must outbid bids: at 50 credits each, 100 fakes cost 5,000 credits, ten times a velvet workshop's income. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards, like an oasis stop keeping its trade.
